Taste Bangkok’s street food vibes at Chatuchak Market! 🍕🥥🍜 Only open on weekends don’t miss it! #ChatuchakMarket #BangkokEats #StreetFoodBangkok #ThaiFoodLovers #WeekendVibes #CoconutIceCream #PadThai #PizzaLovers #BangkokTravel #EatLikeALocal #visitbangkok 🚆 How to Get to Chatuchak Weekend Market (By Public Transport) 📍 Location: Kamphaeng Phet Road, Chatuchak, Bangkok 🕘 Open: Friday–Sunday, around 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM 🚇 By MRT (Subway): • Take the MRT Blue Line and get off at Kamphaeng Phet Station (Exit 2) — the market entrance is right outside. 🚆 By BTS (Skytrain): • Take the BTS Sukhumvit Line and get off at Mo Chit Station (Exit 1 or 3) — then follow the signs to Chatuchak Park and walk 5–10 minutes to the market. 🚌 By Bus: • Several bus lines stop near the market such as Bus No. 3(2-37), 26(1-36), 77, 134(2-20), 136(3-47), 138(4-22), 145(3-18), 517(1-56), 3-19E, 3-24E and 4-22E 📍 https://maps.app.goo.gl/2pLvnYEQxVhjkmz19?g_st=ipc
